title: Incoming mapping-cocone coordinate extensionality
statement: In an abelian category, two chain maps M→mappingCocone(phi) are equal if their composites with the first chain-map projection agree and all their degreewise composites with the second cochain projection agree.

lean.statement:
theorem augmentationCocone_ext {K L M : CochainComplex A ℤ} (phi : K ⟶ L)
    {f g : M ⟶ CochainComplex.mappingCocone phi}
    (hfst : f ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst phi =
      g ≫ CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst phi)
    (hsnd : ∀ i : ℤ, f.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd phi).v
        i (i - 1) (by omega) =
      g.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd phi).v i (i - 1) (by omega)) : f = g
